title: GBM #6: Internship Panel
description: Free pizza for all attendees! Alumni from Google and Jane Street answer questions. SAC 302, bring friends.

title: Build Night
description: Weekly build session. We provide tools and parts; dinner is on your own.

title: Premiere Night: Fall Season
description: Free boba for the first 50 attendees! Screening the top 3 premieres with subtitles.

title: Resume Workshop
description: Free sandwiches for everyone who attends. Bring a printed resume for review.

title: Food for Thought: AI Ethics
description: Weekly debate. This week's motion: should AI write your essays? No food, just arguments.

title: Soldering Workshop
description: Learn to solder! All materials included, $10 materials fee. Pizza for e-board only.

title: Tournament Finals Watch Party
description: Pizza, wings, and soda - all free! Big screen in the Union basement, brackets on the projector.

title: Sunrise Yoga
description: Free donuts for early risers after the session. Mats provided, all levels.

title: Fiesta Wednesday
description: Free empanadas and live music! Dance performances at 1 PM, food while supplies last.

title: Problem Solving Seminar
description: Weekly olympiad-style problems. Quiet room, no food allowed in the library.

title: Ramen Night
description: Free ramen tasting - three broths, all toppings. Veggie options available!

title: Alumni Lunch
description: Catered lunch from Panera will be provided. RSVP required, limited to 40 seats.

title: Food Photography Walk
description: Bring your camera - we style fake food around campus. No real food (sorry).

title: Community Dinner
description: Free biryani dinner for all attendees! Community announcements after Maghrib.

title: Marathon Night
description: Free pizza rolls and a 200-game library. SAC 304 until midnight.

title: Med School Panel
description: Free bagels and coffee. Alumni from Stony Brook Medicine answer questions.

title: Taco Tuesday
description: Free tacos al pastor for the first 100 students! Union Commons, come hungry.

title: Blitz Tournament
description: $50 prize for first place. No food - the pieces are the only thing getting eaten.

title: Cookout
description: Free jerk chicken, rice and peas, and plantains! Music by the DJ collective.

title: Club Tabling
description: Free soft pretzels and lemonade at the welcome tent! 80+ clubs recruiting.

title: Campus Cleanup
description: Gloves and bags provided. Help green the campus - lunch not included.

title: Outdoor Screening
description: Free popcorn! We're showing a classic under the stars. Bring blankets.

title: 5K Fun Run
description: Free breakfast burritos at the finish line! All paces welcome, South P Lot start.

title: Welcome Brunch
description: Brunch is on us! Free bagels, fruit, and coffee. Meet other transfers.

title: Movie Night: Cinema Paradiso
description: Pasta dinner provided - free for all attendees! Discussion after the film.

title: Practice Rounds
description: Weekly practice. Spectators welcome, no food served.

title: Kaggle Workshop
description: Bring your laptop - we'll work through a real dataset together. Snacks not provided.

title: Open Mic Slam
description: Free brownies and lemonade for the audience! Sign up to perform at the door.

title: Donate Blood
description: Free pizza slices for every donor! Walk-ins welcome, ID required.

title: Pho Night
description: Pho and spring rolls - free for the first 75 attendees! Broth taste-off at 2.

title: Info Session
description: Learn the rules, meet teammates, see last year's winners. No food at this one.

title: Harvest Day
description: Help harvest the community garden. We're a food-adjacent club but this is work, not lunch.

title: Stock Pitch Night
description: Free wings during the pitches! Top 3 pitches win interview prep sessions.

title: Lunch Meetup
description: Bring your own lunch - we provide the company and the microwaves.

title: Dim Sum Social
description: Free dumplings, bao, and shumai! Calligraphy station while you eat.

title: Stand-Up Night
description: Free show! Concessions sell snacks (not free, but cheap).

title: Coffee Chat
description: Free coffee and donuts. Ask anything about transferring credits.

title: Tailgate
description: Free hot dogs and burgers before the game! LaValle Stadium east lot.

title: Fall Foliage Hike
description: BYO lunch - we'll stop at the deli on the way to the trailhead.

title: Gallery Opening
description: Free admission (no refreshments). Student work on display through Friday.

title: Halaqa & Snacks
description: Short reminder followed by free samosas and chai for everyone.

title: Research Talks
description: Free subs from Jersey Mike's! Three 15-minute talks by undergrad researchers.

title: Playtest Night
description: Play student-made games and give feedback. Free pizza for playtesters!

title: Fed Speaker
description: Guest lecture on monetary policy. No food - just interest rates.

title: Picnic
description: Free sandwiches, fruit, and lemonade on the lawn! All welcome.

title: Food Bank Trip
description: We're collecting donations for the food bank - bring cans, not appetites.

title: Open Mic
description: Sign up to sing! Audience gets free popcorn between sets.

title: Trivia Night
description: Winning team gets a $20 gift card. No food prizes, just glory.
